relations.title: Minimum Sufficient Control Architecture for AI Enabled Urban Systems
relations.reading: Tuxpan provides a historical comparison for asking which observations are sufficient for a bounded operating objective.

relations.title: When Asking the Question Changes the Answer
relations.reading: A declaration about how performance will be judged can change both reported information and the behavior being observed.

relations.title: The Limits of AI Oversight
relations.reading: The rejected turnstile is a field example of why control value must include its effect on the operating flow, alongside the work and risk it removes.

relations.title: Attribution Gap Measurement Protocol
relations.reading: The independent occupancy channel illustrates the measurement discipline behind separating operational evidence from strategically asserted claims, while retaining each instrument's error model.

relations.title: Optimization, Coherence, and the Frame
relations.reading: The same network can contain harmful local optimization and useful off-map adaptation; their sign becomes clear only after the upstream outcome and its recipient are specified.

relations.title: Car Evolution Mobility OS – Product Annex
relations.reading: The paper transfer protocol offers a concrete way to ask what a mobility commitment must preserve across actors before choosing its digital representation.

relations.title: Tuxpan Urban Service Case Study
relations.reading: Read the engineering case alongside this field note to distinguish the architectural mechanism from the territorial learning that shaped its deployment.

relations.title: Nestlé North America — Where JUBAP Was Named
relations.reading: Tuxpan's adoption layer can be compared with JUBAP's internal facilitation model: the operating practice must become usable and transmissible inside the receiving organization.

relations.title: JubAp.Net 2019 Suite: From Embedded Suites to Operational AI Integrity
relations.reading: The extensible onboard node and the later enterprise suite illustrate a shared architectural question: which investment can host additional capabilities without recreating the operating foundation?

relations.title: xSeil VRP
relations.reading: Analog pooling can inspire a routing model, but xSeil's fully committed demand requires preserving service obligations rather than selecting only the easiest demand to serve.

relations.title: Annex 4 — Canonical Requirements and Test Contract
relations.reading: Good-enough occupancy is decision-specific: evidence sufficient for coordination must be requalified before it is reused for accounting, enforcement or another commitment.

relations.title: Annex 6 — Ablation, Sufficiency and Extensibility
relations.reading: The complementary field layers suggest an ablation plan: remove or replace one mechanism at a time and examine which operating obligations cease to hold.

relations.title: Surviving Capability: Why the Field Celebrates What the Theory Condemns
relations.reading: The companion bridge note qualifies Lesson 6: preserve the capability that works under constraint, while testing its architecture rather than treating scarcity itself as a design advantage.

relations.title: When Asking the Question Changes the Answer
relations.reading: Introducing an observation rule can change the behaviour being measured; the Tuxpan account makes the purpose and adoption of telemetry part of the causal story.

relations.title: Car Evolution Mobility OS – Product Annex
relations.reading: Tuxpan provides a field example of coordinating existing mobility capacity through rights and signals, while the current Product Annex states the scope of today's platform.

relations.title: Cuando las fronteras se hablan y activan entre sí.
relations.reading: The Tuxpan mobility account illustrates cross-frontier activation through adaptation: experience from different operating worlds informed a locally constrained architecture.
